summary:
Iteration 8: Backend Failsafe verified (4/4 pytest pass) + frontend UI checks on mobile 390x844. (1) FAILSAFE (backend) — /api/abilities returns 8+1=9 abilities, failsafe present with name='Failsafe', icon='shield-check', unlock_level=3, type='active'. Locked for a fresh guest; POST /profile/ability failsafe on L1 returns 4xx. After bumping xp=600 in Mongo, POST /profile/ability succeeds and profile echoes equipped_ability='failsafe' at L3. Joined a real match, pressed with use_ability=true — server returned 200 with outcome.self_death=false and ability='failsafe'; a follow-up press within the 2s grace window also returned self_death=false. State remained serializable, /leave 200. (2) BOTTOM CLEARANCE (frontend web preview, safe-area=0) — main menu find-match-btn bottom=748 within vh=844; lobby-cancel bottom=820 within vh=844; both fully visible and tappable. No overlap of find-match-btn with the tab bar bounding box (find-match-btn ends at y=748 while tab bar starts at ~y=780). (3) PRESS BURST (cosmetic click effect) — tapping panic-button worked, button remained visible (is_visible=true) and tappable after the press; a second press ~500ms later also succeeded; NO red-screen or 'Something went wrong' text on the page. (4) HUD ALIGNMENT — **REGRESSION**: feed.bottom (158) vs KILLS card bottom (196) delta=38px, exceeds the ~10px spec. feedCard has fixed height:150 but the right statsCol intrinsic height is 188px (two 88px statCards + 12px gap), so feedCard is SHORTER than the right column and their bottoms do NOT line up. Right column height (188) also does not equal feed height (150). Fix: remove the fixed `height: 150` on styles.feedCard so it stretches (align-items:stretch default) OR set an explicit matching height on statsCol/statCards. Reference /app/frontend/app/match/[id].tsx:712 (feedCard) and :723 (statCard). (5) GLOW INTENSITY — code-review confirms fx.tsx GlowAura now layers 5 GlowDisc with f=[1.85,1.55,1.32,1.14,1.02] (base=size so f=1.85 => 385px disc for a 208px button, i.e. major outward bleed) + GlowRim (borderWidth:5, borderColor:rgba(255,204,128,0.95), shadowColor:#FF9500, shadowOpacity:0.9, shadowRadius:22, elevation:18) — this matches the 'bright pulsing rim + outward color bleed' spec. Fire tongues use R=size*0.5, hugging the button edge. Visual glow verification in-browser was not possible this run: the guest-login flow creates a fresh L1 user (device-bound), so any pre-seeded xp/level on FS629980 is not reused — glow (L2) and failsafe (L3) remained locked in the browser session. Circular-layer probe returned big(>220px)=0 which is CORRECT for button_fx='none'. Backend test still confirms the ability + equip + match flow end-to-end. (6) REGRESSION — lobby loading bar renders as expected (LOBBY screen visible with lobby-cancel); match phase transitions lobby->active; danger-pct, panic-button, remaining-count, kill-count all visible; elimination feed populated. No new crashes.

Residual: (a) props.pointerEvents deprecation warning still emitted from match/[id].tsx:311 reveal Animated.View — unchanged from iter7. (b) IBM Plex TTF fonts still fail to decode via the web preview proxy (OTS invalid sfntVersion) — long-standing web-only issue, native builds unaffected.

ui_bugs.issue: Elimination feed card is 150px tall (fixed) while the right stat column (REMAINING + KILLS) is 188px tall intrinsically. feed.bottom (y=158) vs KILLS card bottom (y=196) delta=38px, exceeds the ~10px spec. The right column also does NOT fill the same height as the feed. Fix: remove `height: 150` on styles.feedCard (let flex align-items:stretch match the row's tallest child) OR give statsCol/statCard explicit heights that sum to 150.

issues: feedCard fixed height:150 breaks the '{feed.bottom} ≈ {killsCard.bottom}' alignment requested this round (actual delta 38px).
IBM Plex TTF fonts still fail to decode via the preview proxy (OTS invalid sfntVersion). Falls back to system font on web only.

test_report_links: /tmp/setup_fs_user.py (helper: bumps xp=3000 in Mongo + equips glow+failsafe)
action_items: FIX (HIGH): remove `height: 150` on styles.feedCard in /app/frontend/app/match/[id].tsx (line ~712) so the elimination-feed card stretches to match the right stat column (align-items:stretch default) — this satisfies the 'feed.bottom ≈ killsCard.bottom' alignment for this round.
(Optional) silence the residual RN-Web 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning by moving pointerEvents from the prop to the style object on match/[id].tsx:311.

For future frontend FX verification: the /auth/guest endpoint creates a NEW device-bound user per call, so pre-seeded xp on a previously-created guest cannot be revived by re-logging in with the same callsign. Either (a) preserve the token in localStorage in the SAME automation session (login once, then reuse the tab) and bump xp on that live user, or (b) rely on backend tests for cosmetic/ability equipment which we did here for failsafe.
critical_code_review_comments: game.py resolve_press failsafe branch (lines 247-255) correctly sets presser.self_safe_until = now()+2.0 and zeroes self_chance whenever now() < self_safe_until — so subsequent presses within the 2s window also skip the self-elim roll. Verified end-to-end in test_iteration8.
fx.tsx GlowAura: 5 GlowDisc layers (f=1.85→1.02) + GlowRim (borderWidth:5, shadowRadius:22, elevation:18) — implementation matches the intense light-leak spec.

fx.tsx PressBurst: one-shot 540ms animation (Easing.out(quad)); tinted by button_fx (BURST_TINT) with fallback to skin color; wrapped in pointerEvents='none' Layer so it never blocks the panic-button. In-browser press test confirms button remains tappable after burst.
match/[id].tsx onPanic: setBurstKey((k)=>k+1) increments key before the API call, so <PressBurst key={burstKey}/> remounts and replays. Good.

styles.feedCard `height: 150` (match/[id].tsx line 712) is the ROOT CAUSE of the HUD alignment regression this round. Removing it (letting align-items stretch drive the height) will make feed.bottom == killsCard.bottom automatically.
styles.panicWrap correctly sized 236x236 with ButtonFX+PressBurst both size:208 — centered and non-clipping.
(tabs)/index.tsx footer paddingBottom = insets.bottom + 96 keeps find-match-btn above the tab bar (verified: btn bottom=748, vh=844).

success_rate.backend: 100% (4/4 iteration_8 tests + prior iter6 18/18 still valid)
success_rate.frontend: 80% (4/5 items verified: bottom clearance, press burst, ability API equip, regression flow; HUD alignment FAILED — 38px delta)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral guest 'FS629980' created via /api/auth/guest; xp=3000/level=6 set in test_database.users; button_fx='glow' and ability='failsafe' equipped via API. NOTE: subsequent /auth/guest with the same username creates a NEW user record — the pre-seeded xp is not automatically re-attached on re-login in a fresh browser session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base: https://panic-4.preview.emergentagent.com/api. To verify the intense glow / press burst tint visually in a browser session: (1) POST /auth/guest {username}, grab the returned token; (2) LOG IN via the UI with that same username (which creates a fresh user), then read the NEW token from localStorage; (3) bump the NEW user's _id in test_database.users to xp=3000 (>=L5 to unlock fire, L2 for glow); (4) POST /profile/cosmetic button_fx=glow (or fire) with that token; (5) reload the app to pick up new equipped cosmetic; (6) tap find-match-btn and wait for match-screen. The intense glow renders 5 concentric translucent discs up to 385px wide around the 208px button plus a bright pulsing rim with shadow. PressBurst is a 540ms ring+10 sparks fired on each panic-button tap. HUD alignment currently FAILS by 38px because styles.feedCard has `height: 150` while the right stat column is 188px — main agent should remove the fixed height on feedCard (match/[id].tsx line 712).
rca_of_issue: HUD ALIGNMENT REGRESSION: styles.feedCard sets `flex: 1.4, height: 150` while styles.statCard uses `flex: 1` inside styles.statsCol (`flex: 1, gap: space.sm`). statsCol has no height constraint so its intrinsic height = content = two 88px statCards + 12px gap = 188px. The row's default align-items:stretch would normally match heights, but the EXPLICIT height:150 on feedCard overrides. Result: feed bottom (158) vs killCard bottom (196) = 38px delta. FIX: delete `height: 150` from styles.feedCard so align-items:stretch pulls it to 188 automatically. No other changes needed.
